t: My car was hit from behind at a red light this morning. The rear bumper is crushed and the other driver admitted it was his fault.
I reversed into a bollard in the supermarket car park and cracked my rear light. Nobody else was involved.
A lorry drove into the side of my van on the motorway. I am not hurt but the van cannot be driven and I need it for work tomorrow.
My windscreen was chipped by a stone on the ring road. Can I get it repaired under my policy?
Someone keyed my car overnight while it was parked outside my flat. There are deep scratches on both doors.
Since my accident the garage has had my car for six weeks. If you do not pay for the repair this week my lawyer will take you to court.
Water has been leaking from the upstairs bathroom through the kitchen ceiling since last night. The plaster is falling down.
A storm blew several tiles off our roof and rain is now coming into the loft.
Our house was burgled while we were on holiday. They took a laptop, jewellery and a bicycle.
The neighbours' tree fell onto our garden wall and knocked it down.
I spilled red wine on the new sofa. Is accidental damage covered?
My mother is 89 and lives alone. Her boiler broke yesterday and she has no heating or hot water.
Our flight to Lisbon was cancelled and the airline lost my suitcase. I had to buy clothes and pay for an extra hotel night.
My daughter broke her leg skiing in Austria and needs to be flown home. The hospital asks who will pay.
I had to cancel our holiday because I was diagnosed with cancer last week. Can I get the deposit back?
My wallet and passport were stolen in Rome. I need an emergency document to travel home.
The hotel in Crete was nothing like the brochure. I want a refund for the whole stay.
I was admitted to hospital for an appendix operation and I need to claim the costs of the surgery and two nights in the ward.
Can you tell me whether my physiotherapy sessions after the knee operation are reimbursed?
Since my husband died I cannot keep up with the payments and I do not understand the letters about his health cover.
You refused my claim for the MRI scan. This is the third refusal and I will report you to the ombudsman and my solicitor.
I need my prescription for insulin covered. I lost my job and cannot afford to pay for it myself.
A customer slipped on a wet floor in my bakery and broke her wrist. Her lawyer has sent a letter asking for compensation.
While painting a client's flat, one of my workers knocked over a lamp and broke it. The client wants it replaced.
My dog bit the postman on the hand. He needed stitches and says he will claim against me.
We received a court summons: a former tenant says our faulty stairs caused his fall.
Could you tell me where my claim stands? No rush, I am just curious about the next step.
This is the third time I have written. If the claim is not settled by Friday my solicitor will take this to court.
I am disabled and use a wheelchair. The ramp to my front door was damaged in the flood and I cannot leave the house.
A delivery driver crashed into our parked car and drove off, but a neighbour filmed his number plate.
